column1: # comment: "Canonical claim-token layer alignments. CRMinf: a gmeow:ClaimEvaluation \u2014 a context-indexed claim that assesses another claim and expresses its verdict \u2014 is the heritage-argumentation cousin of crminf:I5_Inference_Making (the activity that concludes a new belief about existing ones). closeMatch, not equivalence: ClaimEvaluation is broader (any standpoint-indexed assessment, not only formal inference) and keeps its verdict on the proposition it gmeow:expresses. CiTO: gmeow:supportsClaim / gmeow:attacksClaim are the bipolar-argumentation edges over claim tokens; cito:supports / cito:disputes carry the same support/attack epistemics at the work-to-work citation level \u2014 relatedMatch (different carrier), parallel to the span-to-claim polarity cells in the AI set. ClaimToken itself is prov:Activity by inheritance (the classes set) \u2014 an assertion act is a perdurant with provenance \u2014 so no separate prov cell is minted here."

# # REFUSED (Principle 5 — PROV type disjointness): gmeow:producesClaim → prov:generated / prov:wasGeneratedBy. A gmeow:ClaimToken is a prov:Activity (a perdurant assertion act), but prov:generated/prov:wasGeneratedBy require a prov:Entity, which PROV holds disjoint from prov:Activity. The event→token production is carried by the activity-communication shape, not a generation edge; recorded rather than asserted with the wrong type.

# # REFUSED (Principle 5 — no stable single-proposition class): gmeow:Proposition. crminf:I4_Proposition_Set denotes a SET of propositions held together, not the single truth-apt content; Wikidata 'statement' (Q2684591) is already cellled on gmeow:StandpointClaim in the AI set. No faithful external class for the bare propositional content; its logical form is a logic:FormulaFragment by reference.

# # REFUSED (Principle 5 — no external counterpart): gmeow:expresses / gmeow:evaluates. The content axis (token→proposition) and the subject axis (evaluation→token) have no faithful single-property external term; forcing prov:used or a CRMinf property would misstate the carrier.

column6: crminf:I5_Inference_Making is the activity of concluding a new belief from existing ones; a gmeow:ClaimEvaluation assesses a target claim token and expresses its verdict — the same inference-making act, broadened to any standpoint-indexed assessment
cito:disputes at the claim-to-claim-token level: gmeow:attacksClaim is the attack pole of the bipolar argumentation over claim tokens
cito:supports is a work-to-work citation intent; gmeow:supportsClaim is a claim-to-claim-token argumentation edge — same support epistemics, different carrier
